arguments.value: Antonio Miguel Pozos is a United States District Judge for the Eastern District of Pennsylvania, appointed by President Donald J. Trump in 2026. Born in Berkeley, California, in 1982, he earned his A.B. from Harvard University in 2004 and his J.D. from the University of Michigan Law School in 2007. He began his legal career in private practice in Washington, D.C., and later clerked for Judge Anthony J. Trenga of the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Virginia. He served as a trial attorney in the Fraud Section of the Criminal Division at the U.S. Department of Justice before returning to private practice in Philadelphia, where he also taught as a lecturer in law at the University of Pennsylvania Carey Law School.
